metadata.description: SomeCodecat's multi-agent orchestration setup: route work to Codex and AGY before spending Claude Code's own quota.

plugins.name: multiclaude
plugins.description: Orchestrator + quota: a native dispatch tool and Delegates pane that run Codex/AGY on their own quotas (no forwarder agents), model bands derived from the live catalogs, acceptance gates, quota re-routing, a usage readout (/multiclaude:quota) with real AGY pool % , a setup/health check (/multiclaude:setup), and wallet-headroom hooks before each dispatch.
